```yaml
name: Update compat-table dependency

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 1'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  update-compat-table:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Cancel Previous Runs
        uses: styfle/cancel-workflow-action@0.12.1
        with:
          access_token: ${{ github.token }}

      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install pnpm
        run: |
          corepack enable
          pnpm --version

      - name: Fetch Latest compat-table SHA
        id: fetch-sha
        run: |
          LATEST_SHA=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/compat-table/compat-table/commits/main | jq -r '.sha')
          echo "latest_sha=$LATEST_SHA" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Read Current SHA from package.json
        id: read-current-sha
        run: |
          CURRENT_SHA=$(jq -r '.dependencies."compat-table"' tasks/compat_data/package.json)
          echo "current_sha=$CURRENT_SHA" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Compare SHAs
        id: compare-shas
        run: |
          if [ "$CURRENT_SHA" = "$LATEST_SHA" ]; then
            echo "shas_equal=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          else
            echo "shas_equal=false" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          fi

      - name: Update package.json if needed
        if: env.shas_equal == 'false'
        run: |
          jq --arg sha "$LATEST_SHA" '.dependencies."compat-table" = $sha' tasks/compat_data/package.json > temp.json && mv temp.json tasks/compat_data/package.json

      - name: Run build process
        if: env.shas_equal == 'false'
        run: |
          cd tasks/compat_data
          pnpm run init
          pnpm run build

      - name: Check for changes
        if: env.shas_equal == 'false'
        id: check-changes
        run: |
          git diff --exit-code || echo "has_changes=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: env.shas_equal == 'false' && env.has_changes == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: update compat-table to ${{ env.LATEST_SHA }}"
          title: "chore: update compat-table to latest commit"
          body: |
            This PR updates the compat-table dependency to the latest commit.
            
            - Old SHA: ${{ env.CURRENT_SHA }}
            - New SHA: ${{ env.LATEST_SHA }}
            
            This ensures oxc always has access to the latest JavaScript/TypeScript compatibility data.
          branch: update-compat-table-${{ env.LATEST_SHA }}
          base: main
          assignees: Boshen
          labels: chore
```
